info.name: AppstoreSpy API
info.description:
Google Play and App Store market data.

Set the `API_KEY` collection variable to the key from https://appstorespy.com/account before sending anything.

Generated from AppstoreSpy API at https://api.appstorespy.com/openapi.json.

item.name: App Store
Aggregate App Store developers by HQ country.

query.description: Restrict to developers with this dominant category type

request.description: Per-country totals over all App Store developers: developer count, published apps, and sums of monthly downloads/revenue estimates. The category_type split assigns each developer's totals to their dominant category type. Sorted by downloads descending.

item.name: Search App Store apps by query.

query.description: Country for specific country fields. Default - US.
Fields to return separated by comma(,)

request.description: Free-text search across App Store listings, returning a ranked list of matching apps. To filter on structured criteria such as revenue, downloads or category, use `POST /ios/apps/query`.

item.name: Get similar App Store apps.

request.description: Returns the apps App Store lists as similar to the given app. Set `link` to the reverse direction to get the apps that list the given app as similar to them instead.

item.name: Summarise App Store apps matching a filter.

request.description: Returns aggregate totals for the set of App Store apps matching a structured filter, without returning the apps themselves. Takes the same filter body as `POST /ios/apps/query`.

item.name: Get App Store app by ID.

query.description: Fields to return separated by comma(,)
Country for which return data. By default: US.
Language of meta data. By default: store default language.

request.description: Returns the full App Store listing for a single app, looked up by its numeric App Store id. Use `country` to select the storefront and `language` for the metadata language; `fields` limits the response to the columns you need.

item.name: Queue a recrawl of an App Store app.

query.description: Country for which return data. By default: US.
Language of meta data. By default: en_US

request.description: Queues a fresh crawl of one App Store app for the given storefront and language. Returns 200 once the job is accepted; the updated data appears on the app endpoints after the crawl completes.

item.name: Get App Store app reviews by app ID.

query.description: Fields to return separated by comma(,)

request.description: Returns user reviews for a single App Store app. Reviews are storefront-specific, so `country` changes which set is returned.

item.name: Search App Store developers by query.

query.description: Fields to return separated by comma(,)

request.description: Free-text search across App Store developers using a `field:value` query such as `hq_country:US`. To filter on structured criteria, use `POST /ios/developers/query`.

item.name: Search App Store developers by structured filter.

request.description: Searches App Store developers by a structured JSON filter, with paging and sorting. `GET /ios/developers` covers the free-text equivalent.

item.name: Get App Store developer by ID.

query.description: Fields to return separated by comma(,)

request.description: Returns the App Store developer record for a single developer id, including the developer's publisher identifiers and headquarters country.

item.name: Get Apps Estimates

variable.description: Developer's ids to return separated by comma(,)

request.description: Get Google Play apps estimates

item.name: Get Apps Estimates

query.description: Apps to return separated by comma(,)

request.description: Get App Store apps estimates

item.name: Get Ios app available countries.

request.description: This query returns the list of App Store storefronts available as a `country` parameter.

item.name: Get Ios app available languages.

request.description: This query returns the list of metadata languages available as a `language` parameter.

item.name: Get App Store rankings data

request.description: Returns App Store chart positions over a date range, filtered by storefront, category, collection and platform. One row per app per chart per day.

item.name: Events
Get Google Play LiveOps events for an app.

request.description: Returns the LiveOps events (sales, tournaments, updates, new content) Google Play shows for one app in one country. Responds 202 while a fresh crawl is in progress.

item.name: Get Apps Installs Daily

variable.description: Apps to return separated by comma(,)

request.description:
Get Google Play apps daily installs.

`ipd` is derived from the cumulative install total: each increase is spread evenly across the elapsed days since the total last changed, so collection gaps and lagging reports are amortised rather than reported as a single-day spike. Values are raw and never negative.

Note: these are unsmoothed figures. AppstoreSpy's own charts additionally apply a moving average for readability, so a given day's value may differ from what the UI plots. This endpoint is the underlying data.

item.name: Jobs
List keyword crawl jobs.

request.description: Lists the keyword crawl jobs you have submitted, filtered by store, term, country or last-updated window. Each result carries the job's current state and, once finished, its results.

item.name: Create a keyword crawl job.

request.description: Submits a keyword crawl job for one search term in one store and country. Returns the created job immediately; poll `GET /jobs/search` with the returned id to collect the results.

item.name: Suggestions
Get Google Play keyword suggestions.

request.description: Returns Google Play search autocomplete suggestions for a term in one country and language. Responds 202 with a partial result while a fresh crawl is in progress; `freshness` sets how old a cached result may be before it is recrawled.
